location.name: Selegne River
location.level_note: Unlocked at Level 50. First trip 2026-04-20  -  cleared first exploration mission with bottom rigs + Brutus. JigWinner 8'10" SE confirmed perfect for Baikal Omul on light spoons.

primary_targets: Siberian Taimen (MONSTER class  -  max 60 kg / 132 lb, the headline fish)
Northern Pike (max 18 kg / 40 lb  -  TITANIUM LEADERS REQUIRED)
Lenok (max 10 kg / 22 lb  -  large salmonid, mid-heavy spinning)
Baikal Omul (max 3.5 kg / 7.7 lb  -  JigWinner light spoon)
Arctic Grayling (max 4.4 kg / 9.7 lb  -  JigWinner spoon/spinner)
Humpback Whitefish (max 4 kg / 8.8 lb  -  JigWinner spoon)
secondary_targets: European Perch (max 2.2 kg / 4.9 lb  -  float/light spinning)
Ide (max 2.4 kg / 5.3 lb  -  float, high value at 166 cr)
monster_fish: Taimen-Khan  -  boss-class Taimen (similar to Muskie Golem). The Khan of the entire Selenge River.
fish_value_ranked: Siberian Taimen  -  100 cr/lb (but MASSIVE weight = huge total)

spots.name: Taimen Island
spots.notes: Named for the species  -  this is the Taimen hotspot. Bring heaviest tackle (NileChasseur + GiantSpin 9000 SE).

advanced_license.recommended: Buy unlimited Advanced License  -  1,600 cr is cheap for permanent boat + night access. Taimen and big Pike often respond better to night/dawn fishing.

loadout_strategy.philosophy: Selegne is a multi-class river  -  light spinning for Omul/Grayling/Whitefish, heavy spinning/casting for Lenok/Pike/Taimen, bottom rigs for Burbot. Current 7-rod loadout is well-suited. Critical adjustment: TITANIUM LEADERS on every active rod (Northern Pike + Taimen both have teeth that destroy fluoro/mono leaders).
validated_setups_first_trip_4_20: Bottom rigs (Slots 5/6/7) + Brutus = cleared first exploration mission
JigWinner 8'10" SE + Prima 3500 SE + light spoons = PERFECT for Baikal Omul (user-confirmed)
key_changes_from_saint_croix_loadout: CRITICAL: Titanium leaders on slots 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 (Pike + Taimen present everywhere)
Slot 4 (NileChasseur): TAIMEN HUNTER  -  swap to large spoon (Single Spoon 1 1/2 Oz) or live Common Minnow on heavy hook
Slot 5 (Humerus bottom): Burbot rig  -  Medium Cutbait or Common Minnow on Cap'n Hook #6/0
Slot 6 (Mokonzi feeder): Cold-water groundbait mix (Crimson Cold + CSL Cyclo Shrimp + Oilcake Pele)
Slot 7 (Tribal Totem): Heavy Taimen bottom  -  Common Minnow live bait on Cap'n Hook #7/0 with steel/titanium leader

slots.rod: Brutus 10'10" SE (Match, 11-34 Lb line, Mod Fast)
slots.notes: Brutus has handled Selegne mission fish well in first trip. Float + Large Minnows works for predator strikes; Hook #6/0 fine for medium fish. Could swap to Hook #4 + Bloodworms for panfish/exploration completion.

slots.rod: JigWinner 8'10" SE (Spinning, Light, 1/6-5/8 Oz lure, 4-12 Lb line)
slots.leader: Titanium Leader .005" (CRITICAL  -  Pike bite-off risk on light spinners)
slots.terminal_tackle: Medium Spoon 1/3 - 1/2 Oz #4/0 OR Bullet Spinner 1/2 Oz #2/0
slots.notes: USER-CONFIRMED MVP for Baikal Omul on first trip. Light spoons (1/3-1/2 Oz) load the Light blank perfectly. Add Titanium leader  -  even small Pike will bite through fluoro.

slots.rod: SharpCaster 7'3" (Casting, X-Heavy, 5/8-2 Oz lure, 28.6-66 Lb line, Fast)
slots.terminal_tackle: Bullet Spinner 5/6 Oz #2/0 + Spinner Tail 2" OR Crankbait 6 ft #3/0
slots.notes: Saint-Croix MVP combo (Bullet Spinner 5/6 Oz #2/0) should transfer well. CGT BBgun 4500 (44 Lb drag) handles Lenok class easily. For Pike, swap to Spinnerbait or Crankbait.

slots.rod: NileChasseur 6'3" SE (Spinning, X-Heavy, 1-2 3/5 Oz lure, 46-97 Lb line)
slots.leader: Titanium Leader .0193" (CRITICAL  -  Taimen + Pike both present)
slots.terminal_tackle: Single Spoon 1 1/2 Oz #4/0 OR Cap'n Hook #6/0 with Common Minnow live bait
slots.notes: TAIMEN ROD. 60 kg / 132 lb max  -  needs the heaviest spinning setup. GiantSpin 9000 SE drag handles Congo Kamba so will handle Taimen. Single Spoon 1 1/2 Oz on the drop-and-pause technique mirrors successful Congo Nile Perch tactic.

slots.rod: Humerus 11'1" (Bottom, X-Heavy, 6 1/3-10 1/5 Oz casting, 37.5-72.7 Lb line)
slots.leader: Titanium Leader .018" (UPGRADE FROM Mono Leader .025"  -  Pike present)
slots.notes: Burbot is a cod-like cold-water fish  -  Medium Cutbait on bottom rig is the classic approach. Same bait will draw Pike and Lenok. UPGRADE leader to titanium  -  Pike bite-off destroys mono.

slots.rod: Mokonzi 12'10" SE (Bottom, X-Heavy, 6-9 7/8 Oz casting, 39.7-81.6 Lb line)
slots.groundbait: Crimson Cold 60% / CSL Cyclo Shrimp 20% / Oilcake Pele 20% (cold-water mix)
slots.notes: Cold-water groundbait mix designed for Selegne's cool-water salmonids/whitefish. CSL Cyclo Shrimp aroma penetrates cold water where sweet aromas fail. Burbot will hit feeder + Medium Cutbait reliably. Big drag handles surprise Taimen if it grabs the bait.

slots.rod: Tribal Totem 12'10" (Bottom, X-Heavy, 6-9 7/8 Oz casting, 39.7-81.6 Lb line)
slots.notes: Heavy bottom Taimen rig. Live Common Minnow on big hook = classic Taimen target. Titanium leader essential  -  both Taimen and Pike will bite off fluoro. This is the dead-stick monster rod.

groundbait_mix: CSL Cyclo Shrimp aroma  -  already have

overall_analysis.fit_with_current_loadout: EXCELLENT  -  current 7-rod setup matches Selegne's fish class spread almost perfectly. JigWinner addresses light salmonids, NileChasseur handles Taimen, bottom rods cover Burbot, SharpCaster covers Lenok/Pike. Only critical change: titanium leaders everywhere.

validated_rigs: Bottom rigs (Slots 5/6/7)  -  cleared first exploration mission
Brutus (Slot 1)  -  pulled species variety for exploration
JigWinner 8'10" SE + Prima 3500 SE + Light Spoon  -  perfect for Baikal Omul
first_trip_validated_4_20.user_verdict: Beautiful location with varied fishing. JigWinner finally has a home location where it earns its slot.

overall_analysis.session_potential: HIGH  -  combines exploration completion (13 species), big-fish potential (Taimen 132 lb, Pike 40 lb), and finesse work (Omul/Grayling/Whitefish). Single trip can target volume + trophy + exploration simultaneously.

comparison_to_other_locations.vs_saint_croix: Selegne has bigger trophy ceiling (Taimen 132 lb >> Saint-Croix Blue Cat ~80 lb) but lower volume potential. Saint-Croix wins for cash farming; Selegne wins for trophy hunting + exploration.
comparison_to_other_locations.vs_kaniq: Similar river-salmonid feel, but Selegne adds the monster Taimen tier (Kaniq tops at Chinook ~33 lb). Selegne is a richer location.
comparison_to_other_locations.vs_congo: Congo Trophy Kamba 200+ lb still tops Selegne, but Selegne has better species diversity (13 vs Congo's 16+ but with more class-spread). Selegne is a 'middle ground' between Saint-Croix density and Congo trophy class.
